content: Jisu digwngnv nyi ako mvpu toku
Jisu svpw lo aalwk toku okv svparsvlv a rapkur la ninyigv banggubv vngtoku,

hoka nyi megonv digwngnv nyi ako gadw lo karmu tvla nw gvlo joolwk jito. Jisu bunugv kaibv mvngjwng nama kaagv rikula digwngnv nyi anga minto, “Ngo gv kuunyilo nga, ator bvkv! Noogv rimur vdwa mvngnga jipvkunv.”
Vbvrikunamv Pvbv tamsarnv megonv bunu minsunyato, “So nyi si Pwknvyarnvnyi nyarjitaridu!”
Jisu chinto bunugv mvngnam a, vkvlvgabv nw minto, “Nonuno ogulvgabv svkvnv alvmanv go mvngdunv?”
“Noogv rimur ham mvngnga jipvkunv vla minam mvre, vmalo gudungto okv vnglaku vla minam mvre, ogolo angv minpu yapv?

Nyia Kuunyilo ngv nyiamooku so rimur a mvngnga nvnv doodunv vla ngo nonua kaachin modukubv ritam reku.” Vkvlvgabv nw digwngnv nyi anga minto, “Gudungto, noogv gadw nga naarap tvka okv naambv vngnyikuka!”
Nyi angv gudung toku okv naambv vngtoku.
Vdwlo nyi vdwv um kaapa tokudw, bunu busu nyatoku, okv Pwknvyarnvnyi hartv nyato hvkvnv jwkrw aya nga nyi vdwlo jilwk jinam lvkwnglo.
Jisu Metiunyi goklin toku

Jisu ho mooku a vngyu toku, okv ninyigv vngdungrilo, nw lampu naaya nvgo kaapato, aminv Metiu, nw ninyigv opislo dooto. Jisu ninyia minto, “Nga vngming gvlaka.” Metiu gudungdanv ninyia vngming gvtoku.
Vdwlo Jisu Metiu gv naam
lo dvnam dvla doorilo, lampu naayanv okv toa kunam nyi achialvgo Jisu gvla ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwgv dvku tvbul lo aapwng mingvla dvmin gvto.
Parisis megonv hum kaapato okv ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwa tvvkato, “Ogulvgabv nonugv Tamsarbo vkvnv nyi vdwa lvkobv dvbam tvngbam dunvdw?”
Jisu tvvpala bunua mirwksito, “Nyi chvrv nvngv daktor dinchi madunv, vbvritola yvvdw lvvma dvnv hv bunu dinchi dunv.

Darwknv Kitaplo ogu vla minpvdw vngla kaabwk tvka: ‘ngoogv mvngnam v aya kaapa minsunam si, svnwngsvmin erin-peelwknam hum yama.’ Ngo mvngdvnam nyi vdwa gokbv aama, vbvritola toa kunam nyi vdwam yabv.”
Yiknam lvkwng nga tvunam
Vbvrikunamv Jon baptist gv lvbwlaksu vdwv Jisu gvlo aala tvvkato, “Ogulvgabv ngonu la Parisis vdwv yiknama ridarira gvre, vbvritola noogv lvbwlaksu vdwv lvkoka yiknam go rikw madunv?”

Jisu mirwksito, “Nonuno vbv dvmin dunvri nyidalo nyi vdwv mvngrula paapumgvjinvgv lvkobv doodubv? Vbvrirung mare! Vbvritola alu go looreku paapum gvji bonga bunugv loka naaro dukubv, okv vbvrikubolo bunu yiknam a rirap rekunv.
“Yvvka jvtvlaklwk ainapin lo anwnvgo hamtak lwknv kaama dunv, ogulvgavbolo anw hamtak lwknam angv takgv la okv jvtvlaklwk ka abuyayabv ungko nga kotv moyare.

Okv yvvka anggor ala anw nga anggor ala aku gvnvnv pumchup lo pwlwknv kaama, pwlwk kubolo pumchup v boktakre, okv anggor ala ngv sarlinre, okv pumchup v alvkumare. Vmabvya anggor ala ngvla pumchup v anyiv alvdubv, anggor ala anw nga pumchup anw lo pwlwk yadunv.”
Nyigam gv kuunyijar okv Jisu gv vji a mvsitnv mvvga

Vdwlo Jisu vbv mindung rilo, rigvdogvnv Jius nyi ako ninyi gvlo aala, ninyigv kaagialo lvbwng kumpvla, okv minto, “Ngoogv kuunyijar v vjak dadi siyibv; vbvritola no aala noogv laak v lakpv jibolo nw turri kunvpv.”
Vkvlvgabv Jisu gudungla okv ninyia vngming gvtoku, okv ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwv ninyia lvkobv vngming gvtato.
Mvvga ako nyingring gola nyingnyi go oyi sarla silvkumanv, Jisu gv adar lo aatoku okv ninyigv vji a mvsit to.
Hv atubongv minsuto, “Ngo ninyigv vji a mvsit mwngbolo, ngo poyariku.”
Jisu kaitkarla ninyia kaapato, okv minto, “Ngoogv kuunyijar a mvngrw laka! Noogv mvngjwng ngv nam poya mopvku.
Vbvrikunamv Jisu ho rigvdogvnv nyi agv naam lo vngtoku. Vdwlo nw siku gv siinyimar gv adua okv nyi vdwgv adupvbin a kaiyayabv tvvpa tokudw,
Nw minto, “Nyichar mvnwngngv, agumbv linroto! Vmi nyijar angv simakv—nw yupdung mwngdunv!” Vbvrikunamv bunu mvnwngngv ninyia nyarji nyato.
Vbvritola baapubv nyi vdwv agum linro sopikda, Jisu nyijar angv gv karchung lo aatoku okv ninyigv laakka gakbwngto, okv nyijar angv gudung toku.
Svbvrinam gv yunying ngv ho mooku mvnwng hoka dupwng toku.
Jisu nyikchingnv nyi anyigo mvpu toku
Jisu ho mooku a vngyu toku, okv nw gv vngdungrilo, nyikchingnv nyi anyigo ninyia vngming gvrapto. Bunu gokto, “Dabid gv Kuunyilo, ngonua aya mvngpa labv!”
Vdwlo Jisu naam agi arwngbv aatokudw, nyikchingnv nyi anyi vka aaming gvto okv bunua tvvkato, “Ngo nonyia mvpu nyure vla, nonyiv mvngjwng dunvri?” “Tamsarbo, vkv!” vla bunyiv mirwkto.
Vbvrikunamv Jisu bunugv nyik a mvsit toku okv minto, “Nonyi gv mvngjwngnam lokv vbvrirung jilaka!”—
okv bunyi gv nyik v nyiktarla kaapa toku. Jisu bunyia kaagapla minto, “Sum yvvnyika minji mabvka!”
Vbvritola bunyiv vnglaku okv Jisu gv lvkwnglo yunying nga, ho mooku mvnwnglo dusik motoku.
Jisu gangkaknv nyi ako mvpu toku
Nyi vdwgv vngyu rikulo, nyi mego uyuvram naanam nyi ako gaam milin nyuma nvgo Jisu gvlo aagv jito.
Vbvritola uyuvram a chara ronam gula, nyi angv gaam rarap toku, okv nyichar mvnwngngv tvngarvnga nyatoku. Bunu hartvla minto, “Ngonu Israel mooku so vdwloka svkvnvgo kaakw mapvnv!”
Vbvritola Parisis vdwv minto, “So si uyuvram vdwa rigvdogvnv hvkvgv jwkrw a ninyia jipv nvgo, uyuvram vdwa chara dubv.”
Jisu nyi vdwa aya mvngpa toku
Jisu banggu vdwlo okv nampum vdwlo vnggo karto. Nw Jius kumkunaamlo tamsarto, Tvvpunv Yunying nga Karv gv lvkwng nga japgo jito, okv nyi vdwa nvgwngnv achiayakla, lvvma nvnga mvpujito.
Nw nyipam vdwa kaadung dula ninyigv haapok v bunua aya mvngpato. Ogulvgavbolo bunua ridur nvgo kaamabv mvngru nyato, svlar lartwng go kaayanv kaamanv jvbv.
Vkvlvgabv nw ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwa minto, “Aam nvvse ngv awgo doodu, vbvritola nvvkum yaji nvngv miang go.
Rongo atua kumto ho nw aam nvvjinv vngmu gvrila ninyigv aam a nvvkum modukubv.”
